# Office.com

> Office.com is Microsoft's cloud-based productivity platform featuring Microsoft 365 Copilot AI, collaboration tools, and core applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Office.com serves as the central hub for Microsoft 365 services, enabling users to create, collaborate, and share documents with AI-powered assistance. The platform supports multiple languages and regions through worldwide localization.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365 Copilot
- AI-powered productivity
- Collaboration tools
- Word
- Excel
- PowerPoint
- Outlook
- Content creation
- Email drafting
- Cloud storage
- Multi-language support
- Regional localization
- AI assistant

## Core Platform

- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate](https://www.office.com): Microsoft 365 Copilot homepage for AI-powered productivity and collaboration across Office applications.

## Localization & Regional Access

- [Office.com Worldwide](https://store.office.com/worldwide.aspx): Language and regional selection for Office.com worldwide access with multi-language support and geographic routing.
